entries.search: Trump leaves the US line on Falklands sovereignty open Donald Trump told reporters he reviews every position when asked whether he was reconsidering US support for British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands. Washington officially takes no side but practically recognises British administration. The review is reportedly part of Pentagon measures to incentivise NATO allies like the UK to hit a 5 percent defence spending target.
